deselectRepository.note: Repository deselection makes membership differ from the group (remoteExact false), refusing the check.

discussionChanges.note: External source drift (including same-head discussion) appears as an observedSource different from the key, so candidateCurrent fails.

headChanges.note: A head change is also source drift detected by observedSource != key.

publish.note: Publication requires checkedCurrent and the captured fence equal to current authority.

recheck.note: The final source/authority recheck reaches Observed only when the source, membership and local authority are current.

removeInstallation.note: An inactive installation observed via observe makes locallyAuthorized false, refusing calls and publication.

retry.note: A drifted check returns to NoCheck and a new check can begin; the request outcome and schedule belong to valueRequests.

removalBeforeCommitRefusedTest.note: An installation removed after the recheck makes canPublish false; workUnits lawStaleFenceRefused also refuses the append.

sameHeadDiscussionDriftRefusedTest.note: The source digest covers more than the head SHA, so discussion drift refuses the check.

sourceMayAdvanceAfterObservationTest.note: Publication is a point-in-time observation; later drift does not alter the published retained result.

appendConcurrent.note: Concurrent appends cannot move the captured boundary; later pages must agree.

consume.note: Consumption happens only after the complete captured lineage is ready and returns a distinct verdict.

corruptBytesOrLineage.note: Corrupt bytes or lineage refuse the read as Invalid, never zero.

firstPage.note: The first page fixes the sequence bound and total count.

nextPage.note: Later pages continue from the exact cursor within the captured boundary.

sourceChanged.note: A changed source digest, rubric or legacy head yields Stale.

missingNotZeroTest.note: Missing evidence is Incomplete, not a zero assessment.

stablePageBoundaryTest.note: The captured through/total stay fixed while the server grows.

staleDistinctTest.note: Changed source is Stale, distinct from Incomplete and Assessed.

appendRecord.note: Append requires named predecessors to exist and still be current, then retires them; difference: appendLegacy for single-source records retires whatever is current without a predecessor check.

competingAppend.note: A competing writer's append retires the predecessor, making a stale draft's predecessor non-current.

duplicate.note: An assessment key appends at most once, so a replay cannot add a competing verdict; the stored record remains the value.

prepare.note: Drafting a record from the current head is folded into the record's named parents checked by canAppendJoint (workUnits); no separate state.

correctionRetainsRootTest.note: A correction appends a successor and retires but retains the root record.

duplicateUsesStoredValueTest.note: A duplicate assessment key is refused, leaving the first stored record.

stalePredecessorRefusedTest.note: A record naming a retired predecessor, or omitting a current owner, is refused (joint path).

assessA.note: A call needs a current check, no retained result and admission capacity (at most three counted attempts).

beginPreCallA.note: The pre-call check starts only while the request owns the group.

beginPublicationA.note: Publication proceeds only while owning under the captured fence.

busyB.note: An overlapping live group refuses the lease and the request retries (Retry).

collectA.note: Owning requires the collected sources to equal the complete group bound by the input digest.

currentA.note: An already-current assessment completes as Current without a call (valueHistory mayReuseCurrent supplies alreadyCurrent).

finishA.note: The owner completes its request with the Published outcome.

finishPreCallA.note: The final check rereads ownership; an expired lease returns NoCheck so no call is made.

holdA.note: The whole group is owned only if no other live request owns it.

incompleteA.note: Incomplete group collection is SourceIncomplete and waits without spending.

partitionA.note: A complete claim partition is required before publication.

publishA.note: Publish appends the exact retained result once.

recordA.note: Usage is recorded and saved regardless of later lease expiry.

refuseA.note: Without current ownership canPublish is false and the request refuses; the retained result stays reusable.

retainA.note: Retention requires saved usage and a valid result; the earliest retained result wins.

reuseA.note: A retained result yields RetainedResult and is published without another call.

startA.note: A delivery claims the inference key with a fresh token and deadline.

startB.note: Same as startA for the second delivery.

tick.note: Time advances through observe; leases are valid strictly before their deadline.

expiredPublicationReusesInferenceTest.note: A retained result survives a refused publication and a later owner publishes it without a second call.

leaseExpiryDuringInferenceStillKeepsReus.note: Recording, saving and retaining do not require ownership, so a started call's result is retained and later reused.

leaseExpiryDuringPreCallCheckPreventsSpe.note: Lease expiry during the check makes finishCheck return NoCheck and canCall false.

missingGroupCannotSpendTest.note: An incomplete group is SourceIncomplete and makes no call.

overlappingConsumerWaitsThenReadsCurrent.note: The blocked consumer retries and later completes as Current.

wholeGroupOwnershipExcludesOverlapTest.note: A live owner of the group refuses the second request's entire group.

begin.note: The check begins only while owned and locally authorized.

call.note: A call needs a checkedCurrent request and a held reservation.

checkInstallation.note: Installation authority is part of the reread Authority.

checkRegistry.note: Registry revision/restriction is reread in finishCheck via locallyAuthorized and checked == authority.

checkRequest.note: The request lease must still be live at the final check.

checkSource.note: The source group lease must still be owned at the final check.

expireRequest.note: Time advancing past the deadline makes the request not live.

expireSource.note: Source lease expiry makes owns false.

remoteReply.note: The membership reply must cover exactly the group; a failed read leads to a refused check.

restrictProject.note: A registry restriction is observed as a new Authority (inactive or new revision).

suspendInstallation.note: Suspension is observed as an inactive Authority.

activeAuthorityReachesProviderTest.note: With current authority and leases the check is Observed and the call proceeds.

alreadyStartedCallRemainsRecordedTest.note: A started call records its charge without ownership and keeps its slot after lease expiry or suspension.

expiredRequestAfterAuthorityStillPrevent.note: An expired request lease fails the final check.

expiredSourceAfterAuthorityStillPrevents.note: An expired source lease fails the final check.

laterRevocationDoesNotUndoCompletedCheck.note: The successor's call action atomically re-evaluates checkedCurrent against current authority, so the legacy acknowledged window (revocation between local check and external send) is abstracted to shell evidence of the non-transactional provider send; the prose notes a started call still records its charge.

pauseDuringMembershipPreventsCallTest.note: A restriction during the remote read changes authority so the check fails; valueRequests maps it to AuthorityWait.

requestExpiryBetweenLeaseReadsPreventsCa.note: Request expiry before the final read fails the check.

suspensionDuringMembershipPreventsCallTe.note: A suspended installation fails locallyAuthorized; valueRequests maps inactive installation to Retry.

unavailableMembershipPreventsCallTest.note: A membership read not matching the group refuses; a thrown read is Retry in valueRequests.decide.

claim.note: Unread, expired-running or due waiting rows are claimed with a fresh token and lease, clearing outcome and retry time.

finish.note: Same as finishAt with the execution clock.

finishAt.note: Finish needs the current token and an unexpired lease; final outcomes complete, blocked ones count an attempt; difference: the successor has no separate captured clock (see capturedClockAtExpiry gap) and backs off exponentially instead of one tick.

obsolete.note: Same as obsoleteAt with the execution clock.

obsoleteAt.note: A stale token, non-running row or expired lease cannot finish; the obsolete path is the negation of canFinish.

projectActive.note: Project activity is a registry observation; an inactive one resumes nothing.

resumeParked.note: An active repository gives parked requests a retry time of now, checked in rotation.

tick.note: Time advances.

capturedClockAtExpiryIsRefusedTest.note: valueRequests.finish uses only the execution clock; add a caller-captured timestamp parameter to canFinish requiring capturedAt < leaseUntil (and retryAt computed from it), so a finish whose captured time is at or past expiry is refused even while the execution clock is still within the lease.

completedHasNoCurrentLeaseTest.note: A completed row cannot be finished again.

oldLeaseCannotCompleteTest.note: Only the current token can finish.

parkedWaitsForActivationTest.note: Parked has no retry time until an active registry check resumes it.

queuedFinishAfterExpiryIsRefusedTest.note: Execution at or after expiry fails liveClaim.

staleQueuedTokenCannotCompleteCurrentLea.note: A stale token cannot finish the newer lease.

transientRetryDoesNotAdvanceBlockedCount.note: Retry does not count as a blocked attempt.

unclaimedHasNoCurrentLeaseTest.note: An unread row with token 0 cannot finish.

waitingHasNoCurrentLeaseTest.note: A waiting row is not running and cannot be finished; the blocked attempt was counted.

authenticate.note: HMAC over the exact received bytes precedes everything else.

bindValue.note: The value source is bound once and is immutable afterwards.

complete.note: Completion marks the receipt processed; difference: successor also completes ignored or valuation-only outcomes without a queue send.

enqueue.note: The queue send; an acknowledged send moves to completion.

parse.note: Strict UTF-8 and JSON object decoding follow authentication.

queueFailure.note: A rejected or lost-ack send releases an ordinary receipt unless a reopen source is retained.

receive.note: The receipt is claimed only after decode; the first claim fixes the delivery ID.

retainReopen.note: A reopen source is pinned before sending and keeps the receipt on failure.

lostAckMayRedeliverTest.note: A lost ack releases the receipt so a redelivery may queue again while the value source stays bound.

unauthenticatedCannotPersistTest.note: Claiming requires the CanClaim phase reachable only after authenticate and decode.

publish.note: Publication requires every claim assigned exactly once; validJointUnits requires every review used once.

unit.note: Each unit takes claims and reviews used exactly once; positive review credit needs an eligible (non-self) review.

partialPartitionNotPublishedTest.note: A partition missing a claim is refused, so nothing is appended.

selfReviewNotCreditedTest.note: A self-review is not eligible, so it can only carry ReviewNone.

appendRecord.note: One atomic append records the row with its sources, claims and predecessors and retires predecessors; a stale fence, inactive installation or omitted owner refuses.

capture.note: The fence captured before collection must equal the current fence at append, and the installation must be active.

collect.note: Each source must be public, in Slopbot value scope, registered and closed before the API start; any ineligible source refuses the whole request.

envelope.note: Only a labelled subscription producer with a deployed producer revision is accepted; the bundle flag is not modeled (see reconstruct gap).

failure.note: Generic transport/internal failure leading to 409 without state change; successor transitions are atomic so a failure is simply no transition.

headers.note: HTTP method/same-origin and request-body parsing are shell adapter checks stated in historicalImport.md prose; the pure model starts at a parsed ImportRequest.

preflight.note: Joint preflight is carried: named predecessors must be current (predecessorOk/omitsNoCurrentOwner) and a source already in the joint journal cannot take the single route; difference: the single-route stale-predecessor check (parent == tip) has no successor rule (see the differentKeysCannotForkOnePredecessorTest gap).

readback.note: Post-commit readback/response transport; the successor append is atomic and append-only (workUnits stepJournalIsAppendOnly), so a lost readback cannot undo the row.

receipt.note: Composite test-harness helper (receipt) chaining legacy steps; not a product transition.

registryChanges.note: A registry/manifest change advances the journal fence so an append captured under the old fence refuses.

removeSource.note: Source deselection is a manifest change that advances the fence, refusing the pending append.

revokeInstallation.note: Installation events are applied to the import state and an inactive installation refuses intake; workUnits canAppendJoint also requires I::active.

concurrentReplayAfterPauseReturnsExistin.note: The first record for a key stays and a replay never replaces it; difference: replay is a refusal rather than a 200 with the existing payload.

jointSuccessorIndexesItsJointParentTest.note: A joint successor names and retires its current joint predecessor in the same append.

lateInstallationRemovalRefusesInsertTest.note: An inactive installation at append refuses.

lateRegistryChangeRefusesInsertTest.note: A registry change after capture advances the fence and the append refuses.

lateSourceDeselectionRefusesInsertTest.note: Deselection is a manifest change that advances the fence; the append refuses.

lostHttpResponseKeepsSuccessfulJournalTe.note: A lost HTTP response does not affect the appended record.

oneInvalidJointSourceWritesNothingTest.note: Every source of a joint import must be eligible; one ineligible source refuses the whole submit, writing no record.

retryAfterLostReplyUsesStoredRowTest.note: A retry with the same key keeps the stored record; difference: the successor refuses the retry rather than answering 200 with the stored row.

beginPublish.note: Publishing the owner's draft is the owner revision publication against the expected revision; the successor guards it server-side with expectedRevision == revision rather than the client draftBase check.

choose.note: No successor rule for the project image field's selection lifecycle: a selection allocates a decode job owned by the current field generation, only from idle or error, and the field is busy until it settles; add canChoose/choose with generation ownership.

closeDepartedBitmap.note: Disposing a decoded bitmap whose field lifetime departed is a browser memory-management detail; it changes no product-visible state beyond the generation guard requested in the encodeCurrent gap.

decode.note: Native browser image decoding is an external event; the successor would only need the owned-delivery and error transitions (see the gaps for encodeCurrent/decodeReject).

decodeReject.note: A decode rejection for the current job must put the field in a retryable error, while a rejection for a job of a departed generation must not touch the new field; add a generation-guarded decodeReject.

discardDraft.note: Explicit discard must reset and remount the image field into a new generation so stale decode callbacks of the old generation cannot apply; no owner manage draft discard rule exists (only lawDiscardClears for the administrator manifest).

editHeadline.note: The owner manage page keeps an unsaved draft whose base is the last committed project revision; no successor machine models that draft or its base (only the administrator manifest draft is specified); add an owner manage draft with edit/base tracking.

encodeCurrent.note: Only the current-generation job may deliver its encoded image, and delivery must rebase the draft onto the parent's current committed revision (draftBase), not the revision when decoding started; add encodeCurrent with that ownership and rebasing rule.

invalidImage.note: Canvas/encoding/admission failure of the owned decoded image must dispose it and return the field to a retryable error with no image; add invalidImage to the image field machine.

leaveField.note: Leaving the setup wizard step must cancel ownership of any pending image selection; add a leaveField transition to the image field machine.

publishCommit.note: The committed publish appends the next immutable revision; the client-side rebasing of a draft edited during the save is not modelled (see editHeadline gap).

rejectType.note: Unsupported MIME types must refuse before any decode and leave the field retryable (error phase); add a rejectType transition to the image field machine.

remove.note: Removing the custom image is a draft edit that must keep the current draft base; the successor only states the display fallback (presentation projectImage) and has no owner draft edit for removal; add it to the owner manage draft machine.

returnToField.note: Returning to the wizard step must start a new field generation so a decode started before departure is discarded; add returnToField with a fresh generation.

busyFieldRefusesSecondSelectionTest.note: The generic busy-control law refuses activation while the field is decoding; the field's own busy phase is not modelled (see choose gap).

decodeRejectionRetriesTest.note: After a decode rejection a new selection can succeed; requires decodeReject/choose.

departedDecodeRejectionDoesNotChangeNewF.note: A rejection from a departed generation must leave the new field's decoding job untouched; requires a generation-guarded decodeReject.

discardedDecodeTest.note: Discard during decoding must leave no image and the late decode discarded; requires the image field generation rule.

encodingFailureRetriesTest.note: After an encoding failure a new selection can succeed; requires invalidImage/choose.

imageEditedDuringSaveRemainsDraftTest.note: keptManifestDraft/lawLaterEditSurvivesAcceptance cover only the administrator manifest draft; add to the owner manage draft machine a rule that an image edit made while the owner's publish is in flight stays a draft rebased onto the newly committed revision.

invalidDecodeClosesTest.note: Encoding failure ends in a retryable error with no image; requires invalidImage.

invalidTypeRetriesTest.note: After an unsupported type the field accepts a new selection; requires rejectType.

laterImageCanPublishWithoutArtificialCon.note: After the owner's own publish, a later image must publish without a stale-base conflict; requires draft rebasing onto the committed revision.

overlappingGenerationsTest.note: A decode of a discarded generation must not override the new generation's image; requires generation ownership.

publishedParentUsesCurrentCallbackTest.note: An image delivered after the parent published must be based on the new committed revision; requires the encodeCurrent rebasing rule.

rejectedDecodeHasNoBitmapTest.note: A rejected decode yields error with no image; requires decodeReject.

removalKeepsCurrentDraftBaseTest.note: Removing the image after a publish must take the current committed revision as the draft base; requires an owner manage draft remove rule.

successfulDecodeTest.note: Successful owned decode sets the image and returns the field to idle; requires encodeCurrent in an image field machine.

wizardDepartureStillDiscardsPendingSelec.note: Leaving and returning to the step must discard a pending selection; requires leaveField/returnToField.

accessLost.note: A 401/403/404/410 refusal is NoAuthority, which clears rows to Denied.

accountChange.note: Another account signing in starts a new navigation lifetime, clears private rows and erases the private draft.

beginMark.note: Marking a notice read is allowed only for the current recipient; the client's pre-send actor/epoch capture is abstracted to the server recipient check and navigation epochs.

depart.note: Leaving the page increments the navigation epoch so later private responses cannot publish.

departedResponse.note: A response for a departed epoch is refused and changes nothing.

duplicateClick.note: A busy mark control refuses a second activation; read is also idempotent because canRead requires readAt == 0.

finishMark.note: The read time is recorded once; the readback publishes through navigation's private-read guard.

more.note: Loading the older Inbox page is pagination forward; the cursor-based fetch is the read lifecycle.

newViewDraft.note: Test-harness setup creating a replacement view's draft after departure for departedActionTest; the protecting rule is navigation canReceivePrivate's epoch guard.

publish.note: Only a response for the current actor and navigation epoch publishes private Inbox rows.

refreshPrivateReports.note: A refresh of the private reports from a ready view is a new request on the same resource that keeps the last good rows.

requestPage.note: An Inbox page read is the shared read lifecycle; its account/navigation lifetime ownership is navigation's canReceivePrivate.

sendMark.note: The mark request is sent for the notice's recipient only; a different or signed-out actor is refused by canRead.

signOut.note: Sign-out clears private rows, the report draft and mounted details.

verifiedOutage.note: A transport outage on a refresh (NoService with a snapshot) keeps the retained rows as Stale; the legacy required fresh same-session match is navigation's actor/epoch guard.

accessLossTest.note: Losing access during a refresh yields Denied with no rows.

actorChangeTest.note: An account change starts a new lifetime with no private rows; composition stepAccountChangeClearsDraft erases the draft.

crossTabReturnTest.note: After the account change, a read for the new actor and epoch publishes that actor's rows.

departedActionTest.note: A departed view's mark response is refused, so the replacement view is not changed.

duplicateMarkTest.note: A busy mark control refuses duplicate clicks; notifications canRead (readAt == 0) keeps the read single.

pagingTest.note: Paging forward moves to the next existing page.

sameActorOutageTest.note: An outage on refresh keeps the retained rows as Stale for the same actor.

activeFocus.note: A same-account focus refresh changes nothing, so it cannot supersede an in-flight mutation's readback; the legacy explicit suppression flag is not needed.

beginMutation.note: The read/acknowledge mutation is admitted only for the notice's current recipient; the client's action-ownership capture is abstracted to navigation epochs.

changeCursor.note: Moving the Inbox cursor is pagination; refusing it during a mutation is the busy-control law (ui/controls lawBusyRefusesActivation).

confirmAfter.note: The readback after a mutation publishes only for the same actor and epoch.

confirmBefore.note: The pre-send actor check is carried by the server requiring the actor to be the recipient; a signed-out or switched account cannot mark another's notice.

cookieChanges.note: Environment event: the cookie changing is not observed by the app until a session read; the successor only reacts through refreshIdentity/signIn/signOut.

depart.note: Departure starts a new navigation epoch, so no later readback can publish.

finish.note: Internal release of the useAction busy flag; the successor's busy behaviour is ui/controls activates and has no separate finish transition.

admit.note: The legacy server admits a write only when the session cookie actor equals the actor the request captured (expected-actor fence); successor authorized() binds the authority read to the session actor 'by' but has no expected-actor input, so add an expectedActor field to Creation/OwnerChange and refuse when it differs from 'by'. spec/backend/accounts.md names the x-slop-expected-github-id header (requireActor, 403 actor_changed) only as a prose shell obligation outside its model, and projects.md models no such fence, so the rule must be added to the Creation/OwnerChange/Removal inputs of spec/backend/projects.md.

precheck.note: Promise-continuation microstep (pre-dispatch identity read) of the legacy identity check; it has no separate meaning and belongs to the missing consume/dispatch lifetime transition recorded as a gap.

receive.note: No successor machine owns the removal/cancellation request lifetime of the project editor and saved-application list; add to spec/frontend/projectDrafts.md a story where a reply applies only to the owning lifetime and a lost or refused reply shows an error without undoing a committed action.

remount.note: No successor machine owns the removal/cancellation request lifetime of the project editor and saved-application list; add to spec/frontend/projectDrafts.md a story where a remounted editor ignores replies of the previous lifetime.

server.note: Removal rechecks current authority on the primary repository and appends a paused retired revision (or returns unchanged); cancellation needs the applicant. Difference: no expected-actor fence, the session actor is 'by'.

submit.note: Test-harness convenience sequence (begin, precheck, dispatch); its component steps are reconciled individually.

success.note: Test-harness convenience sequence (server, receive, postcheck, finish); its component steps are reconciled individually.

actorChangesAfterCommitHidesTerminalTest.note: No successor machine owns the removal/cancellation request lifetime of the project editor and saved-application list; add to spec/frontend/projectDrafts.md a story where an actor change after commit hides the terminal and shows an error.

actorChangesAfterPrecheckRefusedAtServer.note: An actor swap after the precheck must be refused at the server by an expected-actor fence on removal/cancellation; the successor Removal has no expected-actor input. spec/backend/accounts.md names the x-slop-expected-github-id header (requireActor, 403 actor_changed) only as a prose shell obligation outside its model, and projects.md models no such fence, so the rule must be added to the Creation/OwnerChange/Removal inputs of spec/backend/projects.md.

cancellationShowsDistinctTerminalTest.note: No successor machine owns the removal/cancellation request lifetime of the project editor and saved-application list; add to spec/frontend/projectDrafts.md a story where cancellation shows its own terminal distinct from removal; the server side is sometimesCancelledUnpublished in spec/backend/projects.md.

departedPrecheckCannotDispatchTest.note: No successor machine owns the removal/cancellation request lifetime of the project editor and saved-application list; add to spec/frontend/projectDrafts.md a story where a precheck finishing after departure dispatches nothing.

departedResponseDoesNotReplaceNewEditorT.note: No successor machine owns the removal/cancellation request lifetime of the project editor and saved-application list; add to spec/frontend/projectDrafts.md a story where a reply for a departed lifetime does not replace the remounted editor.

departureAfterIdentityReadCannotShowSucc.note: No successor machine owns the removal/cancellation request lifetime of the project editor and saved-application list; add to spec/frontend/projectDrafts.md a story where departure after the post-commit identity read shows no success.

lockBlocksPublishDuringCancellationTest.note: No successor machine owns the removal/cancellation request lifetime of the project editor and saved-application list; add to spec/frontend/projectDrafts.md a story where an in-flight cancellation blocks publication in the same view. spec/ui/controls.md lawBusyRefusesActivation is only a generic busy-control law and does not bind busy to an in-flight project write, so it does not carry this.

lostResponseKeepsCommittedActionTest.note: A committed removal is permanent and a retry after a lost reply returns success unchanged; the client error view is not modelled.

permissionFailureNeverShowsSuccessTest.note: Without verified current authority removal is refused and nothing commits; the client error view is not modelled.

removalShowsTerminalAfterCheckedReceiptT.note: No successor machine owns the removal/cancellation request lifetime of the project editor and saved-application list; add to spec/frontend/projectDrafts.md a story where the removed terminal is shown only after a delivered accepted reply and matching identity re-read; the server retirement itself is sometimesOwnerRemoved in spec/backend/projects.md.

unavailablePostcheckKeepsCommittedAction.note: No successor machine owns the removal/cancellation request lifetime of the project editor and saved-application list; add to spec/frontend/projectDrafts.md a story where an unavailable post-commit identity read shows an error while the committed removal stays.

activate.note: Activation needs current authority, every repository installed, complete fields and current clearance (scan or exemption) with no restriction.

advance.note: Three-step navigation is a rendering detail; spec/frontend/presentation.md acceptedSetupPresentation requires the Project, Rewards and Review steps.

back.note: Three-step navigation is a rendering detail; spec/frontend/presentation.md acceptedSetupPresentation requires the Project, Rewards and Review steps.

conflict.note: A stale expected revision is refused and nothing changes.

edit.note: Form-field validity is abstracted into the backend creationValid input (fieldsComplete, license, facts) of spec/backend/projects.md.

installApp.note: Activation requires an installed Slopbot on every listed repository.

save.note: Saving appends one immutable revision only against the expected revision (revision 0 for creation).

scanExempt.note: An exemption (frozen migration-0075 set or audited owner-approved grant) clears a repository with its own basis, never shown as a passed scan.

scanPassed.note: A clean admission scan result is recorded against the current repositories and clears them in the enforcement machine.

verifyAuthority.note: Authority is one verified read bound to the acting account and the stored primary repository.

exemptionTest.note: An exempt repository is cleared so activation proceeds, and the exemption is never displayed as a scan.

revisionTest.note: After a save the old expected revision conflicts and the stored revision is unchanged.

setupTest.note: Authority, installation and a clean scan together allow activation; sometimesActive in projects.md witnesses the reachable active state.

age.note: A snapshot older than the stale threshold is marked stale; the legacy boolean 'old' is the elapsed-time predicate.

expand.note: The project work list presentation is not specified; add to spec/frontend/views.md a rule that at most ten suggestions show initially, an explicit expansion shows every eligible item, and expansion survives a failed refresh.

failed.note: A failed read is Failed without a snapshot and Stale with retained rows when a snapshot exists.

keep.note: Stutter step of the legacy model.

loaded.note: The current read publishes rows as Current, or Empty for zero items.

pause.note: The project work list presentation is not specified; add to spec/frontend/views.md a rule that an inactive (paused) work view shows no suggestions and resumes the retained list when active again.

resume.note: The project work list presentation is not specified; add to spec/frontend/views.md a rule that an inactive (paused) work view shows no suggestions and resumes the retained list when active again.

retry.note: A retry starts a new request while retained rows stay until the result.

collapsedTest.note: The project work list presentation is not specified; add to spec/frontend/views.md a rule that more than ten items show ten with an expansion control while all remain reachable.

emptyTest.note: Zero items show Empty, distinct from failure.

expandedRefreshTest.note: The project work list presentation is not specified; add to spec/frontend/views.md a rule that an expanded list stays expanded and stale after a failed refresh.

expansionTest.note: The project work list presentation is not specified; add to spec/frontend/views.md a rule that expansion shows every item and removes the control.

failureTest.note: An initial failure shows Failed, never Empty.

loadTest.note: A loaded snapshot shows its rows as current (count shown is presentation).

pausedTest.note: The project work list presentation is not specified; add to spec/frontend/views.md a rule that an inactive work view shows nothing.

retainedTest.note: A failed refresh keeps the last good rows as Stale.

retryTest.note: A retry after failure can load current rows.

changeActorProp.note: A new profile actor is a new resource that clears data and invalidates in-flight reads; the legacy component lacked this synchronous guard.

deliverFailure.note: A failure is published only by the current non-cancelled request.

deliverSuccess.note: Only the current request publishes its validated result.

depart.note: Leaving cancels local ownership of the pending read; its outcome can no longer publish.

normalizedKeyUnchanged.note: An unchanged normalized key is not a new resource, so no read restarts.

observePublicQuery.note: The server answers a link only when both the link and the membership are public.

openPublicLink.note: Opening the external X link is navigation with no Slop state change; the only safety fact, that a link exists only from a public read, is publicXProfile in spec/backend/accounts.md.

previewOrigin.note: Non-product (preview) origins must render no X link and issue no public X profile query; add this origin gate to the profile story of spec/frontend/views.md.

publication.note: Environment change to the membership and link rows; the public read publicXProfile in spec/backend/accounts.md defines which rows are visible.

queueFailure.note: A failed read is ReadError/NoService, shown Failed or Unavailable.

queueMalformed.note: A malformed identity is BadData, shown Invalid (or Stale with a snapshot).

queueSuccess.note: Promise-queue microstep between server observation and delivery; merged into receive of spec/frontend/requests.md.

replaceProfile.note: A different normalized profile key starts a new lifetime and aborts the old reads.

startRead.note: Starting the profile read sets Loading with a new request id.

suppressQuery.note: Non-product (preview) origins must render no X link and issue no public X profile query; add this origin gate to the profile story of spec/frontend/views.md.

viewerChanges.note: Environment input; the public X read takes no viewer (publicXProfile), so the viewer is not part of the resource key in spec/frontend/requests.md.

abortedReadDoesNotShowErrorTest.note: A cancelled read cannot publish its later failure.

actorChangeHasNoSynchronousSuccessGuardT.note: Witness of a legacy defect (an old actor's queued response could write the new actor's view); the successor intentionally forbids it: canReceive in spec/frontend/requests.md accepts only the current resource, lifetime and request id.

currentActorResponseReplacesOldQueuedSuc.note: The current actor's reply publishes; in the successor the old reply is refused outright.

lateNullCanReplaceCurrentActorAccountTes.note: Witness of a legacy defect (an old actor's queued response could write the new actor's view); the successor intentionally forbids it: canReceive in spec/frontend/requests.md accepts only the current resource, lifetime and request id.

lateSuccessDoesNotWriteNewInstanceTest.note: A late reply of a replaced lifetime cannot publish.

laterPrivacyChangeDoesNotEraseObservedRe.note: A validated reply for the current request publishes what the server observed; later row changes need a new read.

loadingHasNoLinkTest.note: Loading carries no current rows, so no link renders.

missingLinkIsMissingTest.note: A missing link yields noLink, not an error.

missingMemberIsMissingTest.note: A missing or closed member yields noLink.

newMountObservesCurrentPrivacyTest.note: A new lifetime reads again and observes the current privacy.

normalizedRouteKeyDoesNotRestartReadTest.note: The same normalized key does not select a new resource.

previewDoesNotRequestTest.note: Non-product (preview) origins must render no X link and issue no public X profile query; add this origin gate to the profile story of spec/frontend/views.md.

privateLinkIsMissingTest.note: A private link yields no link.

privateMemberIsMissingTest.note: A private membership yields no link.

publicLinkReadyTest.note: A public member with a public link yields the link; display is the Current read state.

unavailableReadTest.note: A failed read shows a failure with no link.

viewerChangeDoesNotRefreshPublicLinkTest.note: The viewer is not part of the public read's resource key, so a viewer change starts no read.

passDeadlines.note: No successor rule models the local time boundary that changes deadline advice; add a clock input to spec/frontend/views.md whose passing changes labels only.

renderRetry.note: Add a rule that after a submission's deadline an uncertain send shows 'check again' advice while the stage stays Uncertain until a matching receipt.

renderReview.note: Add a rule that the local clock passing a historical cycle's review deadline changes only advice (Under review to Awaiting approval) and never the persisted cycle state; new months have no review window (CLAUDE.md), so this applies to historical cycle records only.

retryDoesNotConfirmTest.note: An uncertain submission becomes Received only with a matching receipt, so no clock-driven advice confirms it; the deadline advice text itself is not modelled.

reviewDoesNotApproveTest.note: Add a rule that the local clock passing a historical cycle's review deadline changes only advice (Under review to Awaiting approval) and never the persisted cycle state; new months have no review window (CLAUDE.md), so this applies to historical cycle records only.

displayPaid.note: Paid is shown only with exact finality for an approved award.

finalizedEvidence.note: Exact finality is the exactFinality fact the display reads.

readFailure.note: A failed read is never shown as Empty (Failed, or Stale with a snapshot).

reportRevised.note: A report revision appends a new version digest to the retained history and grants no award.

reserve.note: A reserved or scheduled approved obligation is displayed by settlementDisplay as ReadyToPay or ScheduledPayment (or a funding/wallet state), never PaidPayment; the lifecycle itself is owned by settlement specs.

submit.note: A submitted payment is displayed as Submitted and keeps its obligation.

failureNotEmptyTest.note: After a failure the status is not Empty.

noPrematurePaidTest.note: Reserved and submitted payments never display Paid.

reportRevisionHistoryTest.note: The version history keeps every prior report version with the current one last.

changeRepository.note: Convenience for choosing repository 2; same rule as chooseRepository.

chooseRepository.note: Choosing another repository is a new resource: data cleared, lifetime advanced and in-flight results invalidated.

clearDescription.note: The setup repository lookup's field behaviour is not specified (projects.md treats lookups as stateless shell reads); add to the setup story of spec/frontend/presentation.md a rule that a cleared description takes the next repository's suggestion.

depart.note: Leaving cancels ownership of the pending lookup so its reply cannot publish.

dispatch.note: requests.md starts a request immediately; add a scheduled (debounced) phase that is cancelled by a resource change, invalid input or unmount before any network request starts.

editDescription.note: The setup repository lookup's field behaviour is not specified (projects.md treats lookups as stateless shell reads); add to the setup story of spec/frontend/presentation.md a rule that a description the user typed survives lookups and repository changes.

failed.note: Test-harness convenience sequence (receive invalid then publish).

invalidRepository.note: The setup repository lookup's field behaviour is not specified (projects.md treats lookups as stateless shell reads); add to the setup story of spec/frontend/presentation.md a rule that invalid or cleared repository input clears the facts, branch and source and cancels the pending lookup (requests.md selectResource requires a positive resource).

oldPublish.note: Historical negative control (old unguarded publication) excluded from the legacy step relation; the successor carries only the guarded canReceive.

publish.note: Only the current request for the current repository publishes; an invalid response publishes no facts (BadData). Branch and description handling are separate gaps.

receive.note: Response-arrival microstep; merged into the guard of receive in spec/frontend/requests.md.

receiveEvidence.note: Response-arrival microstep; merged into the guard of receive in spec/frontend/requests.md.

restoredDraft.note: Opening the page resumes the saved setup draft slot, including its repository, branch and text.

retry.note: A retry after failure issues a new request id.

schedule.note: Starting a lookup for a selected repository is request; the legacy debounce timer phase is not modelled (see dispatch).

selectBranch.note: The setup repository lookup's field behaviour is not specified (projects.md treats lookups as stateless shell reads); add to the setup story of spec/frontend/presentation.md a rule that a chosen branch binds its own commit from the fresh branch inventory and an absent commit map never invents a source commit for a bounty-only setup.

clearedBeforeDebounceStartsNoRequestTest.note: requests.md starts a request immediately; add a scheduled (debounced) phase that clearing the input before the debounce fires starts no request.

clearedTextTakesNewSuggestionTest.note: The setup repository lookup's field behaviour is not specified (projects.md treats lookups as stateless shell reads); add to the setup story of spec/frontend/presentation.md a rule that a cleared description takes the new suggestion.

currentFactsTest.note: The current repository's reply publishes its facts.

departedDebounceCannotDispatchTest.note: requests.md starts a request immediately; add a scheduled (debounced) phase that unmount before the debounce fires starts no request.

departedResponseCannotPublishTest.note: A cancelled lookup's reply cannot publish facts.

failedLookupRetriesWithNewControllerTest.note: A retry with a new request id can publish current facts.

newSuccessSurvivesOldFailureTest.note: A later old failure is refused, so the current facts stay.

obsoleteFactsTest.note: A reply for the earlier repository is refused after the change.

oldFailureCannotReplaceNewLoadingTest.note: An old failure cannot change the new request's Loading state.

oldUnguardedResponseMixesIdentityTest.note: Historical negative control (old unguarded publication) excluded from the legacy step relation; the successor carries only the guarded canReceive.

receivedOldFactsCannotPublishAfterEditTe.note: A received reply for the replaced repository cannot publish.

begin.note: request starts a pending read for the current resource and keeps the last good snapshot (kept data) for the same resource lifetime.

changeLoader.note: A changed loader is a new resource identity: selectResource clears rows and snapshot and starts a new lifetime so the old cache is not reused.

checkedRetentionMode.note: Checked (administrator) retention mode, where a timeout drops the retained record and a transient failure retains it only when retention was explicitly allowed, has no successor rule; requests.md always retains a snapshot on BadData/NoService/ReadError. Add a per-resource retention policy (public vs checked) to ReadState and make receive clear rows on timeout or unverified transient failure under the checked policy.

depart.note: Departure cancels local ownership; cancel clears pending and bumps requestId so the departed reply cannot be received.

failure.note: receive with NoService/ReadError keeps a prior snapshot as Stale and NoAuthority clears rows to Denied; the legacy retentionAllowed flag is not modeled (see checkedRetentionMode gap).

lateOutcome.note: canReceive requires the read to be pending and the requestId current, so an outcome after settlement is ignored.

retainedMode.note: Public retention of the last good snapshot on a failed refresh is the default of requests.md receive (hasSnapshot leads to Stale); there is no separate mode switch.

success.note: receive with HasRows publishes Current only for the matching resource, lifetime and requestId; a non-owned reply is refused by canReceive.

timeout.note: The hook deadline settles the pending read once as a failure outcome (receive with ReadError/NoService), after which pending is false so later outcomes are refused; no explicit deadline timer is modeled.

adminTimeoutCannotRetainUnverifiedRecord.note: Under checked retention a timeout must drop the retained record (data 0, error); requests.md always keeps the snapshot as Stale. Needs the checked retention policy described for checkedRetentionMode.

authoritativeFailureDropsRecordTest.note: NoAuthority clears rows and snapshot to Denied even when a snapshot existed.

changedLoaderDoesNotReuseCacheTest.note: selectResource on a new identity clears rows and snapshot so the new request starts Loading without the old cache.

checkedTransientFailureRetainsRecordTest.note: A transient failure with a prior snapshot yields Stale; the successor does not distinguish the explicit retention permission.

departedResponseIsIgnoredTest.note: After cancel the reply fails canReceive, so no data is published.

publicTimeoutCanRetainOldRecordTest.note: A failed refresh with a prior snapshot yields Stale with the last good rows.

retryAfterTimeoutCanSucceedTest.note: After a failure a new request can be issued and its success publishes Current; the old reply is refused.

successBeatsLaterOutcomeTest.note: The first success publishes Current; the later outcome fails canReceive.

timeoutBeatsLateSuccessTest.note: After the settling failure the read is no longer pending, so the late success is refused and status stays Failed without data.

uncheckedTransientFailureDropsRecordTest.note: A transient failure whose retention is not allowed under checked mode must drop the record; requests.md retains it as Stale. Needs the checked retention policy.

age.note: A displayed snapshot becomes stale more than 8 hours after generatedAt; the legacy untimed age step is concretized.

authoritativeFailure.note: NoAuthority clears rows and snapshot to Denied.

cancel.note: cancel ends local ownership of the pending read.

completeRead.note: Complete and valid page collection is the adapter's validation before the result is classified; it is merged into requests.md receive (HasRows only for a validated complete result, BadData otherwise).

lateReply.note: A reply after cancel fails canReceive (requestId changed, not pending).

publish.note: receive with HasRows publishes Current with the validated rows for the current request.

refresh.note: request starts a refresh from a published snapshot, keeping hasSnapshot.

retry.note: After an error a new request may be issued for the same resource.

transientFailure.note: NoService/ReadError keeps a prior snapshot as Stale, otherwise Unavailable/Failed.

accessLossTest.note: An authoritative failure clears the retained data.

cancellationTest.note: Cancellation without a snapshot is Cancelled and the late reply is refused.

partialTest.note: A failure without a prior snapshot is an error state with no rows.

refreshFailureTest.note: A transient refresh failure with a snapshot yields Stale with the old rows.

staleTest.note: An aged published snapshot is labelled stale.

approveManifest.note: A manifest is admissible only when it names its reviewer, decision and reason (maintainer-reviewed manifest).

advanceWindow.note: Once journaled the reviewers and shares are fixed, so advancing the scoring window never redistributes; the legacy issued/retained split by current window is not represented.

allocate.note: The pool is capped by the assessment, split by band with largest remainder tied by first time then review ID, and journaled; the successor uses 10-Point units.

choose.note: Test harness configuration of pool size, bands, ties and windows; the successor quantifies over these through its simulation value sets.

configure.note: Nondeterministic wrapper over choose (test harness).

ingest.note: Qualifying reviews are recorded in time/ID order; an out-of-order review restarts the record before journaling instead of accepting arbitrary order directly.

ingestNext.note: Ordered-ingestion reduction of ingest used for bounded simulation.

produce.note: Composite harness sequence of configure, ingestion and allocate.

advancingWindowKeepsSharesTest.note: Journaled reviewers and shares cannot change when the window advances.

currentWindowDoesNotRedistributeTest.note: Shares are computed from the merged PR's reviewers independent of the current scoring window and are fixed once journaled.

firstTimeIdAndRemainderTieTest.note: Equal remainders resolve by first review time then review ID; legacy 1-point pools become 10-Point units.

orderedIngestionReachesSameAllocationTes.note: Ordered ingestion (with restart on out-of-order input) reaches the same first-five allocation.

outsideAllocationTakesNoSlotTest.note: Reviews outside the acceptance-anchored allocation window must take no reviewer slot; reviews.md qualifies only bounds a review by the merge time (at < mergedAt) and has no lower window bound, so an out-of-window first review would occupy a slot. Add an allocation-window lower bound to qualifies (e.g. e.at >= allocationFrom) with a law that out-of-window reviews never take a slot.

outsideOnlyTakesNoSlotTest.note: Reviews outside the acceptance-anchored allocation window must take no reviewer slot; reviews.md qualifies only bounds a review by the merge time (at < mergedAt) and has no lower window bound, so an out-of-window first review would occupy a slot. Add an allocation-window lower bound to qualifies (e.g. e.at >= allocationFrom) with a law that out-of-window reviews never take a slot.

sampledPoolTest.note: Pool bound, at most five distinct reviewers hold for every reachable record.

failure.note: Local error display of the dormant component; failed filing appends nothing in the backend.

loadStatus.note: The member's own flag status read returns only that member's own flag (FlagWithEvidence) and hides others.

observePause.note: Two distinct active flaggers place a FlagQuarantine, visible publicly as a flag-only pause.

recorded.note: The flag is appended to the record (and quarantines a clear project on the second distinct active flagger).

signedOut.note: Local signed-out view of the dormant, unmounted ProjectRiskFlag component; the backend refuses an unsigned flag because eligibleFlagger requires by > 0.

submit.note: Filing requires an eligible flagger at the current revision, a fresh receipt and no other active flag by the same actor.

withdraw.note: The reporter withdraws their own flag; withdrawal stops it counting and keeps history.

writeEvidence.note: Local evidence text entry of the dormant component; the 20–4000 character evidence bound is enforced by the flags route (prose in enforcement.md).

pauseSurvivesWithdrawalTest.note: Withdrawal only marks the receipt withdrawn and never lifts the FlagQuarantine; only a reinstatement decision or fresh clean scan lifts it.

signedOutTest.note: Local signed-out state of the dormant unmounted component; no backend transition, and eligibleFlagger refuses by == 0.

accept.note: Nondeterministic wrapper choosing credit arguments (test harness).

advance.note: The journal clock only moves forward.

ban.note: A ban is recorded as an observation and appends no revision.

credit.note: One current accepted work unit is credited once per project and unit in its accepted period, with co-authors as recipients of the same unit; the legacy refusal of new credit to a banned actor is not a guard of canCreditUnit.

acceptedTest.note: An accepted unit gets one credit revision.

coAuthorTest.note: Co-authors share one unit's value as multiple recipients of a single revision rather than two events.

existingCreditSurvivesBanTest.note: A ban observation never rewrites recorded Points.

monthIsolationTest.note: Credit is keyed per unit and bound to the unit's accepted period, so work in another month is separately credited.

projectIsolationTest.note: The award key includes the project, so identical units in different projects are credited independently.

blocked.note: A blocked label or human gate excludes with Blocked/HumanGated.

claimed.note: A maintainer claim excludes with reason Claimed; the item stays in the census.

classify.note: decide gives Candidate exactly when no reason applies; offered lists only unblocked items.

missionReady.note: Both ready labels (help wanted, mission-ready) are abstracted as contributorReady; neither lifts a security or blocking exclusion because blocked ORs every reason.

pullRequest.note: Item kind PullRequestItem selects the pull-request readiness and review reasons.

recoveredFiles.note: A recovered diff (diffAvailable) removes DiffUnavailable so the item can be a candidate again.

reviewRequested.note: An active review request excludes with ReviewRequested.

security.note: A security label excludes with SecurityLabel.

unavailableFiles.note: An unavailable pull-request diff fails closed with DiffUnavailable while the census row is kept.

unknownAuthor.note: UnknownAuthor fails closed with reason AuthorUnknown.

untriaged.note: An issue without a contributor-ready label is Untriaged and not offered.

activeReviewTest.note: An active review request excludes a pull request.

changesRequestedTest.note: Changes requested excludes and is listed as a reason.

claimedTest.note: A claimed item is Excluded yet retained in the census.

missionReadyBlockedTest.note: A blocked label excludes even with a ready label.

missionReadySecurityTest.note: The security label excludes even with a ready label.

missionReadyTest.note: A ready-labelled human issue with no other reason is a Candidate.

readyIssueTest.note: A help-wanted human issue is a Candidate.

recoveredDiffAllowsReviewTest.note: With the diff available and no other reason the pull request is a Candidate again.

unavailableDiffRetainsCensusTest.note: Unavailable diff excludes the item while the census keeps its row.

clearCase.note: Closing a detail removes only that submission's mounted body.

createdReply.note: Where an asynchronous creation callback selects a case is a local rendering/history detail; report creation itself is drafts.md receiveReceipt via composition submitReport, and no history write is modeled.

detailReply.note: A detail reply mounts only for the current actor, current navigation epoch and authorized case read.

focus.note: Focus re-reads the session; the same account keeps its lifetime (the successor keeps the mounted detail instead of hiding and re-reading it), another account or none clears private data.

identity.note: The identity read signs in, signs out or keeps the account exactly as the explicit transitions do, within the requesting epoch.

initialQuery.note: A deep link is kept as the requested destination through sign-in and grants no authority; the case identifier inside the Security cases page is abstracted into the Page.

oldLocalSelection.note: Negative control for the retired list button, excluded from the production step relation.

refusedDetail.note: A refused case read (caseReadAuthorized false) mounts nothing.

selectCase.note: A case body is mounted only by an authorized read for the current actor and epoch keyed by its own submission, so selecting another case never shows the old body; the successor keeps a set of independently opened details rather than one selection.

readReceipt.note: Reading back the completion is merged into the atomic finish.

receipt.note: The completion receipt is written only after every page verifies and matches the manifest digest.

recordPage.note: The page record is merged into page verification, which extends the verified prefix.

replay.note: Operator replay of failed work resumes at the same cursor.

restore.note: The chain check verifies the completion digest and every page digest; difference: the successor has no unique-object / totals check (see duplicateObjectRefusedTest).

expire.note: Closing a generation's references marks them as meeting the retention predicate (closed, 90 days, non-permanent), collapsed to referencesEligible as in the legacy eligibility abstraction.

failedState.note: Lost replies are abstracted: every successor step is atomic and committed markers, receipts and records are permanent (operations/backup.md stepTargetsNeverRemoved), so a failure leaves state unchanged.

finishGeneration.note: A generation retires only when every reserved target, unpublished ones included, is marked and recorded.

finishPut.note: Create-only completion of an admitted write; refused after the marker (canWriteTarget requires not marker).

finishRecorded.note: test harness composite of successor-covered steps; recordRetirement with readback maps to operations/backup.md recordRetirement.

freeze.note: Cleanup freezes a generation only after a complete snapshot, with retirement released and every reference eligible; the successor adds the earlier-cycles-complete and release-variable guards.

historicalOverwriteMissing.note: Negative control of the replaced absence-then-unconditional-marker protocol, excluded from the legacy step; the successor's markTarget derives Missing only from an unwritten target and canWriteTarget forbids writes after the marker.

holdLegacy.note: A legacy null-generation object records RetentionHeld and is never deleted.

holdShared.note: A generation with a current or permanent reference does not satisfy referencesEligible, so it is never frozen; the successor has no explicit retention-held result row for this case.

inspect.note: Inspection of the target's bytes and prior receipts is merged into operations/backup.md markTarget, which derives Backed/Changed/Missing from the written flag and exact copy.

preserve.note: Successful admission evidence is marked permanent and canExpireReference excludes permanent references, so the generation cannot meet the retention predicate.

primaryCopy.note: The primary daily snapshot copies and verifies object pages in order; changed bytes are preserved as observed and later classify as Changed.

publishHead.note: Pointer publication of a written target, refused unless the generation is open; per-slot head tuples are abstracted to a per-target published flag.

publishReceipt.note: The immutable per-target receipt is merged into the copy classification set by operations/backup.md markTarget; no separate receipt-before-marker state exists.

readback.note: D1 readback after the retirement record is merged into operations/backup.md recordRetirement, an atomic step whose record is permanent (stepTargetsNeverRemoved).

ready.note: test harness composite of successor-covered steps; expire, primaryCopy, completeSnapshot, freeze map to closeReferences, copyPage, finish, freezeGeneration in operations/backup.md.

recordRetirement.note: The D1 retirement record follows the verified marker of each reserved target.

referenceReceipt.note: A retired generation's reference earns a deletion receipt only when its target is Backed; otherwise retention-missing. The successor settles per target, not per reference over all declared slots.

reserveOldHead.note: Every writer reserves a fresh physical target in an open generation, unpublished old heads included.

restoreSupplement.note: Restoration verifies the complete chain and exact read-back bytes and otherwise refuses; the successor restores cycle pages and does not distinguish a supplemental retirement copy or a changed-restored outcome.

retireMissing.note: test harness composite of successor-covered steps; one missing target retirement maps to operations/backup.md markTarget (Missing) then recordRetirement.

retirePrimary.note: test harness composite of successor-covered steps; one backed target retirement maps to operations/backup.md markTarget then recordRetirement.

retireSupplement.note: test harness composite of successor-covered steps; one copied target retirement maps to operations/backup.md markTarget then recordRetirement.

retry.note: Retry is the re-enabled guard of operations/backup.md markTarget/recordRetirement on the single-consumer queue (max_retries = 5); no separate retry counter is modelled.

seedConflictingOrphan.note: Successor has no notion of a pre-existing backup object at a target key that does not bind to this target; add a rule that a conflicting orphan backup never authorizes a marker or receipt and the source is reread (copy refuses).

verifyMarker.note: Marker readback verification is merged into operations/backup.md markTarget ('verified marker'); the D1 record follows only a marked target (canRecordRetirement).

writeSuccessor.note: Writes go to a freshly reserved key in an open generation, never a retired key.

missingReadbackCannotInventDatabaseRecei.note: D1 readback is merged into operations/backup.md recordRetirement; the successor has no separate readback-failure state.

ready.note: Test harness composite of reserved, written and candidateRead.

retirementRecord.note: The retirement record follows the marker.

seed.note: Test harness composite storing one object end to end.

corruptReadDoesNotRepairTest.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; a read of corrupt bytes must report corrupt and never reserve a repair.

existingCopyRetirementBeforeFinalFenceRe.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; retirement between verification and the final active observation must refuse the store.

failedPublicationWithoutWinnerPreservesF.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; a failed publication with no winner must preserve the failure.

freshTargetPublishedThenVerifiedTest.note: Reserve, create-only write and pointer publication store the object; winner verification and the final active fence are not modelled.

genericHeadReadFailureDoesNotWriteTest.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; a head-read failure must stop without reserving or writing.

initialActiveDatabaseFailureDoesNotWrite.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; a D1 failure on the initial active-generation read must stop without reserving or writing.

invalidPayloadReservesNothingTest.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; invalid input must stop before any reservation.

missingCurrentTargetUsesFreshKeyTest.note: Repair of a missing current target uses a fresh key; detection is not modelled.

persistentMarkerBlocksEarlierUnknownPutT.note: After the marker, a late admitted write cannot land and the unpublished target is marked Missing and recorded.

reservationReadbackFailureNeverStartsPut.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; a failed reservation readback must never start the PUT.

retirementBlocksPublicationTest.note: A frozen generation refuses pointer publication.

retiringGenerationReadCanReturnExistingB.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; readPart has no active-generation requirement and may return a still-present retiring generation's verified bytes.

unavailableCurrentTargetDoesNotRepairTes.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; a failed read of the current target must not trigger a repair reservation.

unknownPutReplyDoesNotInventCommittedByt.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; an unknown PUT reply must not count as committed bytes while the PUT is pending.

unpublishedTargetsRetireAfterMarkerTest.note: After marking and recording the unpublished target the generation retires.

validExistingTargetSkipsReservationTest.note: The evidence-storage storePart/readPart helper (head pointer read, reservation readback, verified candidate and winner, final active fence) is not specified; a verified current target is reused without a new reservation, subject to the final active fence.

decodeComplete.note: Successor admission inventory counts fetched entries only and has no transparent compression expansion; add a decode step that releases the wrapper only after complete input consumption, binds the child to its parent and original path, inventories every member header, and quarantines native, unknown or nested-archive children.

corruptOrPartlyConsumedInputStaysHeldTes.note: Successor admission inventory counts fetched entries only and has no transparent compression expansion; undecodable gzip input must stay quarantined as a gap.
